messages:
zoe: quick heads-up — onboarded vectra-lite-v1 (int6-pc) to staging. recall@10 vs maestro baseline on short-multilang (<=7 tok) is -5.9%.
liam: can you paste eval command/dataset?
zoe: `python eval.py --model vectra-lite-v1 --quant int6-pc --dataset short-multilang-7k --metric recall@10 --batch 128`
anya: what about cosine hist and l2 norms?
zoe: summary stats: maestro recall@10 0.78 -> vectra int6 0.73. silhouette maestro 0.49 -> vectra int6 0.35. L2 norms: maestro mean 1.04,std 0.09; vectra int6 mean 0.88,std 0.06.
liam: that looks like norm-collapse / variance loss from PTQ. try querying a maestro-built index with vectra queries to isolate index vs vector geometry.
ops-bot: Started job embed-compare-1755558000 (maestro-index + vectra-queries) — will post results.
ops-bot: Finished embed-compare-1755558000: recall@10 delta -4.6% (maestro-index + vectra-queries vs maestro->maestro).
anya: geometry changed but some neighbor structure remains. try two quick experiments: 1) learn a global L2 rescale factor on holdout and apply to queries; 2) run int8-pc quant as a softer baseline.
zoe: ran global L2 rescale (multiplier 1.18 on vectra queries) on holdout: recall recovered ~3.9% (now delta -2.0%). int8-pc run queued.
liam: if rescale recovers most, we can ship a short-term runtime shim that rescales embeddings for short queries while we fix PTQ calibration. long-term fix: add per-channel scale floors and rounding-aware centering to PTQ.
anya: action items: add unit checks in onboarding harness for L2 mean/std and silhouette (fail if L2 mean delta > 0.12 or silhouette drop > 0.08). capture cosine hist and store plots in ticket.
zoe: opening ticket with plots, scripts, and ops logs. tagging eng-platform to prevent routing vectra-lite-v1 to dedicated until it passes the new gate. thanks all :heart:
